attchmntText: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Loyal Tex received a request from promoter Palaniappan Manivannan on 10/11/2026 to reclassify his shares from promoter to public category. The promoter sold two shares at Rs. 205.50 per share for a total consideration of Rs. 411. He currently holds nil shares and declared he exercises no control over the company. The Board of Directors met on 12/11/2026 and granted in-principle approval for this reclassification. This approval is subject to shareholder approval. Dr. V. Rajesh, the Company Secretary, has been authorized to obtain this shareholder approval. The company has intimated BSE and NSE regarding this development under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates on Appointment of Non-Independent Director
voiceSummary: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has appointed Mr. Gokul S Dixit, DIN 00357170, as a Non-Independent Director, subject to shareholder approval. The Board made this decision following a recommendation from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee meeting held on 12/11/2026. The appointment is effective from 12/11/2026. Mr. Dixit is a Chartered Accountant with a CFA charter and an MBA from the University of Michigan. He has over two decades of experience in accounting, financial markets, and capital markets. He previously served on the Accounting Standards Board of the ICAI. He is not related to any existing board members. The company has filed this notice with BSE and NSE under SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has appointed Mr. B. Vaidyanathan, DIN 00263983, as an Independent Director under the non-executive director category. The Board of Directors made this appointment on November 12, 2026, following a recommendation from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee held on the same date. The appointment is effective from November 12, 2026, and is subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Vaidyanathan holds a B. Tech from IIT Madras and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad. He has extensive experience, including roles at Hindustan Lever, Sanmar Engineering, and BASF Catalysts India. He is not related to any existing board member.

attchmntText: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates on Cessation of Non-Executive Non-Independent Director
voiceSummary: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has informed the stock exchanges that Mr. B. Vaidyanathan, holding DIN 00263983, resigned as a Non-Independent Director due to personal reasons. The resignation is effective from 12/11/2026. The company submitted the resignation letter and required details under SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD1/P/CIR/ 2023/123 dated July 13, 2023, for regulatory compliance. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement serves as formal notification of the change in key managerial personnel. No further details regarding the appointment of a replacement are included in this filing.

attchmntText: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management Appointment of Chief Financial Officer
voiceSummary: Loyal Textile Mills Limited appointed Mr. Nambi Arooran as Chief Financial Officer. The Board made this appointment following a recommendation by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee at its meeting on 12/11/2026. Mr. Arooran’s appointment is effective from 14th November 2026. He is a Chartered Accountant with 24 years of managerial experience in Finance, Costing, MIS, Management accounting, Internal Control system, ERP implementation, and Project Evaluation within the manufacturing industry. His expertise covers sectors including Iron and Steel, Cement, Chemical, Automobile component, Textile, Construction, and Shipbuilding. The company disclosed that there are no relationships between directors. This information is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management Resignation of Chief Financial Officer
voiceSummary: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has informed the stock exchanges that Mr. U Thenappan has resigned as Chief Financial Officer due to personal reasons. He will be relieved from his services with effect from the closing hours of 14th November 2026. The company submitted the resignation letter to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The resignation was approved by the Board of Directors. Details required under SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD1/P/CIR/2023/123 dated July 13, 2023, regarding the change in key managerial personnel have been attached as an annexure. The company secretary, Dr. V. Rajesh, signed the communication on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Loyal Textile Mills Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The board appointed Mr. R. Nambi Arooran as Chief Financial Officer and Mr. Gokul S Dixit as additional director. Mr. U. Thenappan resigned as CFO. Mr. B. Vaidyanathan resigned as non-independent director and was appointed as independent director subject to shareholder approval for a five-year term. The board approved reclassifying Mr. P. Manivannan from promoter to public category, subject to shareholder approval. A notice of postal ballot was approved. Auditors noted continued operational losses and liquidity issues. The consolidated results include unreviewed interim financial information from a joint venture.

attchmntText: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Loyal Tex received a request from promoter Palaniappan Manivannan on November 10, 2026, for reclassification. The promoter sold two shares at Rs. 205.50 per share, resulting in a total consideration of Rs. 411. He now holds zero shares. He declared he exercises no control over the company, holds no board or key managerial positions, and is not a willful defaulter or fugitive economic offender. The company will discuss this request at the Board Meeting scheduled for November 12, 2026. The decision will be communicated after the meeting.

attchmntText: Loyal Textile Mills Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Gokul S Dixit as Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 04, 2026 due to completion of second term of Independent Director.
